
  configuration:
    --prefix=/k/_tools/swoop-encoder-build-0.2.5/prefix
    --target-os=mingw32
    --arch=x86_64
    --enable-gpl
    --enable-version3
    --enable-libx264
    --enable-static
    --disable-shared
    --disable-autodetect
    --disable-network
    --disable-debug
    --disable-doc
    --disable-ffplay
    --disable-ffprobe
    --disable-devices
    --enable-indev=lavfi
    --disable-encoders
    --enable-encoder='libx264,aac,pcm_s16le,wrapped_avframe'
    --disable-decoders
    --enable-decoder='h264,aac,opus,vp8,vp9,vorbis,pcm_s16le,rawvideo,wrapped_avframe'
    --disable-muxers
    --enable-muxer='mp4,null,matroska,webm,wav'
    --disable-demuxers
    --enable-demuxer='matroska,mov,wav'
    --disable-protocols
    --enable-protocol='file,pipe'
    --disable-bsfs
    --enable-bsf='aac_adtstoasc,h264_mp4toannexb'
    --pkg-config-flags=--static
    --extra-cflags=-O2
    --extra-ldflags='-static -static-libgcc'
